'''Timothy Green''' (also published as '''Tim Green''' and '''Tim Greene''')<ref name="dt-19391">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/19391 HDADTJ Rebel Scout style with no R3], DeckTech (Timothy "Rebel Scout" Green, 18 October 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/19391/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/19391/ GitHub Pages].</ref> (DeckTech handle '''Rebel Scout''') posted a [[Dark]] [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi]] list on DeckTech in October 2001.
